style: Avant-garde garage rock and proto-punk theatricality combined with doo-wop vocal-group pop. Harmony system: modal drone harmony with chromatic side-steps, parallel triads moving as a single block, and sharp bitonal layers. Melodic system: angular punk phrasing with narrow repetitive cells opening into chromatic cabaret patter and yodel register flips. Rhythmic system: stuttering stop-start punk rhythm with hard silences, waltz pulse invaded by duple accents, and motorik pulse. Timbre system: fuzz guitar, cheap transistor organ, tambourine, dry close-miked drums, and handclaps. Performance attitude: deadpan bureaucratic solemnity with garage-band recklessness and high theatrical overstatement. Production: 1960s mono room capture with tape saturation and extreme acoustic deadness. Operators: hold vocal melody fixed while guitar drifts; compress rhythmic pulse while stretching vocal melismas; make the guitar behave like a ledger of omissions; preserve the handclap anchor; force conflicting meters to run simultaneously; return to the opening chant in a ruined key.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Spoken deadpan dry voice over dry guitar strums]
The synthesizer is severely broken.
We tested the voltage at node seven with precision instruments.
It does not output any discernible sound.
It outputs mathematical proofs of absence and pure void.
[Sung in close barbershop harmony with absolute pitch]
There is no oscillator here in this casing.
There is no voltage drop across the terminal.
[Spoken]
Proof number one: the sine wave cannot be found anywhere in the room.
Proof number two: the speaker cone remains at absolute rest indefinitely.
We check the terminals for any trace of current flow or anomaly.
We find only the silent footprints of a ghost current wandering.
[Spoken quietly]
Additional diagnostic check: the capacitors are empty vessels.
They hold no charge, only the memory of historical lightning.
We inspect the vacuum tubes for signs of internal glow.
We find only cold glass and the faint smell of ozone.

[Chorus]
[Massed doo-wop vocal group, clapping hands, fuzz organ swells]
Oh, theorem of the empty box and hollow copper!
We measured the wire and found absolute nothingness!
[Fast patter singing]
Absence is proven by three distinct lemmas!
Absence is verified by four missing decimals!
[Sudden stop silences]
[Spoken]
The proof is sound. Therefore, the instrument sings its silent hymn.
[Sung harmonized]
Sing the hymn of the unwritten note and the broken chord.

[Verse 2]
[Motorik rhythm kicks in, frantic bass and drums]
[Recall mold mutation: the proof is now remembered as a physical stain]
We remember the missing voltage with absolute clarity.
It was blue yesterday; today it is completely forgotten by the system.
The memory of the waveform has scarred the circuit board permanently.
[Fast scat syllables functioning as percussion]
Bap-bap-absence! Bap-bap-void! Bap-bap-zero! Bap-bap-null!
[Sung with operatic overstatement]
We compute the probability of a room that was never built!
We trace the impedance of a voice that was never spoken aloud!
We chronicle the precise weight of an unwritten melody in stone!
[Spoken hurriedly]
The database of silence is updating every millisecond.
No new information has been successfully added to the archive.
All parameters remain within acceptable limits of absolute zero.

[Bridge]
[Flow ghoul dissolution: rhythm dissolves into maintenance rates and friction]
[Hocketed vocal fragments split across singers]
Check the solder joints.
Check the heat dissipation.
Check the vacuum integrity.
[Singers alternate rapidly]
Is the absence leaking from the chassis?
Is the void accumulating digital dust on the bus?
Is the silence spreading to the surrounding equipment racks?
[Whispered ensemble rhythm]
Scrape the non-existent residue from the copper trace.
Calculate the rate of decay of a negative integer over time.
Measure the thermal dissipation of a theoretical particle.
Scrape again. Calculate deeper. Measure the void itself.

[Chorus]
[Massed vocal group, frantic swing rhythm, fuzz organ]
Oh, theorem of the empty box and hollow copper!
We measured the wire and found pure nothingness!
[Fast patter singing]
Absence is proven by three distinct lemmas!
Absence is verified by four missing decimals!
[Sudden stop silences]
[Spoken]
The proof is even more absent than it was before calibration.

[Verse 3]
[Axiom vandal: negate the rule that a proof requires a conclusion]
[Screamed deadpan delivery]
We do not reach a Q.E.D.!
We destroy the final line of the formal syllogism!
[The accompaniment drops out entirely, leaving only a dry handclap and a nasal drone]
Without a conclusion, the absence is infinitely valid and eternal.
We are sustained entirely by what is missing from the equation of life.
[Root surgeon: replace the primitive of 'sound' with 'omission']
Recompile the melody using only excluded middle terms and blank spaces.
[Spoken softly]
Let the blank spaces dictate the rhythm of our breathing.
Let the missing notes guide our fingers across the fretboard.

[Outro]
[Mutated return of the opening chant, now distorted and slower]
The synthesizer is deeply and fundamentally broken.
The proof of absence is now running on an endless loop forever.
[Single dry handclap]
[Long silence of the void filling the entire room]
[Final whispered word]
Zero.
caption: An avant-garde garage-punk track where a broken synthesizer outputs mathematical proofs of absence. Driven by taxonomical classification errors, memory mutations, and ontological decompilation, it fuses doo-wop vocal harmonies, deadpan bureaucratic narration, and jagged fuzz-organ arrangements into a strangely rigorous structural meltdown.
